# Town & Country Animal Hospital

> > AAHA-accredited veterinary clinic in Portland, Oregon providing comprehensive pet care services for dogs and cats with preventive wellness programs, surgical procedures, and emergency services.

Town & Country Animal Hospital is a full-service animal hospital located in Southeast Portland, Oregon, led by Dr. Mariah Kimball and serving the Portland and surrounding communities. The clinic offers preventive care, surgical services, dental care, and emergency veterinary services with a focus on pet wellness and quality animal care.

## Key Topics

- AAHA-accredited veterinary clinic
- Emergency veterinary services
- Dog and cat wellness packages
- Spay and neuter procedures
- Dental care and disease prevention
- Vaccination programs
- Arthritis and pain management
- Flea and parasite control
- Surgical procedures
- Dr. Mariah Kimball
- Southeast Portland location
- Pet preventive care
- Poison control resources
- Veterinary team profiles
